item.title: Patch: Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities in F5 BIG-IP
item.description:
F5 BIG-IP: RCE · fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for F5 BIG-IP. The CCB advisories list the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

High · Fix available
